dataset: DIANA II: the Taymanitic dictionary and onomasticon of Al-Jallad 2026 (version 2026.1), one row per headword of the dictionary, the toponym glossary, the group names and the Onomasticon

source.work: Al-Jallad, Ahmad, Dictionary of the Inscriptions of Ancient North Arabia, Volume II: Taymanitic, version 2026.1, Online Corpus of the Inscriptions of Ancient North Arabia (OCIANA), Columbus 2026, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24223110
source.text_layer: the PDF's own (born-digital), read with PyMuPDF

notation.alphabet: the book's transliteration; the sibilants are printed s¹ s² s³ (Volume I prints s ś)
notation.homograph: a small figure above the headword's line in print; stored as an integer
notation.editorial: { } [ ] < > of a reading are kept in headword_printed and dropped from headword
notation.languages: the book's labels (CAr, Am, Hbr/Heb, Arm/Aram, Gz, Sab, Ug; Saf, Dad, Him, Nab …) as the names its List of Abbreviations gives

identity_rule: diana2:p<pdf page>#<n>, n the headword's place among those that begin on that page; an entry running over a page keeps its first page
license_note: CC BY-NC 4.0 (© 2026 Ahmad Al-Jallad): the entries as printed, with their pages, for non-commercial reference; the entries' text unchanged, in another format, beside the index fields forms and match_keys
